item.title: Watch Bono, Eddie Vedder & More Honor Glen Hansard With Emotional Musical Tributes at Dublin Funeral
item.description:
[Ethereal music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: Welcome to this special episode, where we're remembering the life and legacy of Irish singer-songwriter Glen Hansard. On August 4th, friends, family, and fellow musicians gathered at St. Patrick's Cathedral in Dublin to celebrate his life.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Hansard passed away on July 29th at the age of 56, following a motorcycle accident. The ceremony was attended by U2's Bono and The Edge, Pearl Jam's Eddie Vedder, Hozier, and many others who came to pay their respects to this beloved artist.
[Clip of Bono's statement plays]
Bono: "People on the green outside, best friends. People tuning in, best friends. Even people who haven't met him, best friends... Everyone who met him, they just remember the day they met him."
Host: Bono shared a heartfelt statement, highlighting Hansard's remarkable ability to connect with everyone he met. He also shared a voicemail from Patti Smith, featuring a lullaby for Hansard's loved ones, and delivered a spoken tribute inspired by U2's song "Beautiful Day".
[Clip of Eddie Vedder performing "The Song of Good Hope" plays]
Host: Eddie Vedder took the stage to perform one of Hansard's songs, "The Song of Good Hope", a beautiful tribute to his friend and collaborator. He was joined by Markéta Irglová, Hansard's Once collaborator.
[Clip of Richie Hansard's eulogy plays]
Richie Hansard: "Glen said once that when you lose someone, you don't really lose them... If you have the strength and the will, you will gain them back and you inherit the best parts of them."
Host: Hansard's brother, Richie, delivered an emotional eulogy, recalling the musician's outlook on grief and the impact he had on those around him.
[Clip of the final musical tribute plays, featuring "Forever Young"]
Host: The service concluded with a powerful rendition of Bob Dylan's "Forever Young", featuring Bono, Eddie Vedder, The Edge, and many others. It was a fitting farewell to a musician who left an indelible mark on the music world.
[Music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: Glen Hansard's legacy will live on through his music, and the countless lives he touched. We'll remember him as a talented singer-songwriter, and a kind soul who inspired generations of artists. Thank you for joining us on this special episode.
